description: This file defines the EntityCondition interface, which represents various SQL 'WHERE' clause conditions used in the OFBiz framework's entity engine. It includes static factory methods for creating different types of conditions, methods for processing conditions, and documentation for interpreting entity constraints, joins, comparisons, and raw SQL conditions.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: An interface representing a SQL 'WHERE' clause condition in the OFBiz framework. Provides factory methods for creating various conditions and methods for condition validation, SQL string generation, and matching.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a comparison condition between two elements using an EntityComparisonOperator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates an equality comparison condition between a field name and a value.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a combined condition from two existing conditions using a join operator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a combined list of conditions joined with a specified operator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a list of conditions joined with AND operator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a list of conditions with a specified join operator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a field map condition with a comparison operator and join operator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a field map condition with equality operator and join operator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a field map condition with equality operator and AND join operator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a field map condition with specified comparison and join operators, using key-value pairs.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a field map condition with equality operator and specified join operator.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Creates a field map condition with equality operator and AND join operator.

methods.name: makeConditionMap
methods.description: Creates a conjunction of field/value equality comparisons.

methods.name: makeConditionDate
methods.description: Creates a condition to filter rows that are currently valid based on date ranges.

methods.name: makeConditionWhere
methods.description: Creates a raw SQL string condition.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Applies a visitor pattern to process this condition.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE string from this condition.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the condition against the entity model.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Checks if a specific entity matches this condition.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if a map representation of an entity matches this condition using a delegator.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Converts this condition into an immutable, 'frozen' version.
